style="text;html=1;whiteSpace=wrap;strokeColor=none;fillColor=none;align=left;verticalAlign=middle;rounded=0;" value="<div align="left">Justification:</div><div>Lessons are Compositions of Content. Content should not exist outside of a Lesson.</div><div>Lessons can be part of multiple courses, that's why I chose Aggregation. A course without lessons can exist, but doesn't make sense. It is made of lessons.</div><div>The same reasoning applies to the relationship between LearningPlatform and Course</div><div>Users and LearningPlatforms can exist independently from one another -&gt; Association</div><div><br></div><div>It wasn't obvious which Attributes to give to Users: I chose what seemed relevant</div><div>Also: Content s of different types and could be modelled as an abstract class with 3 different children (Text, Video, Quiz)</div><div>Methods to manage Lessons in Course are also not described in the task</div>" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="280" width="440" x="480" y="680" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> </root> </mxGraphModel> </diagram> </mxfile>

div.div: Lessons are Compositions of Content. Content should not exist outside of a Lesson.
Lessons can be part of multiple courses, that's why I chose Aggregation. A course without lessons can exist, but doesn't make sense. It is made of lessons.
The same reasoning applies to the relationship between LearningPlatform and Course
Users and LearningPlatforms can exist independently from one another -> Association
It wasn't obvious which Attributes to give to Users: I chose what seemed relevant
Also: Content s of different types and could be modelled as an abstract class with 3 different children (Text, Video, Quiz)
Methods to manage Lessons in Course are also not described in the task
